Nginx Config Generator

Enter a domain and port to get a production-ready nginx server block, with optional SSL and gzip.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your domain, port, and document root or upstream.
  2. Toggle SSL, redirect, and gzip as needed.
  3. Click Generate — copy or download the server block.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What does the config include?

A server block with listen, server_name, root or proxy_pass, SSL certificates, HTTP→HTTPS redirect, and gzip.

How do I enable HTTPS?

Tick “Enable SSL” and add your certificate and key paths; port 443 and the redirect are added automatically.

Can I serve multiple domains?

Yes — add extra domains separated by spaces and they all go into server_name.

Can I download the config?

Yes — copy it or download it as a .conf file for sites-available.
